notes: FIVE FIXES FROM THE OWNER'S OWN TESTING. (1) Every extra window (Guided Clean, Settings, and the rest) now opens at its real size on a Mac - on some Macs they used to open as a tiny sliver in the corner and never show. Each window is built by the program's own queue pump, the same pattern the Background Check window has always used. (2) The window opens at about seven eighths of the screen wide and three quarters tall, centered, and it remembers the size and place you leave it. (3) Settings has ONE door now: the word at the bottom left; the little gear at the top is gone. (4) Clearer install-source words: an app with no store record says 'No store record' instead of 'Preinstalled' (real factory apps still say so, and still cap at ASK FIRST). (5) On a Mac whose Python was never set up for secure connections, the app now finds the Mac's own certificate bundle by itself, so the threat list and updates reach it again - verified connections only, nothing weakened. Same Light Professional face, same verdict engine - ad software alone still convicts, factory apps still cap at ASK FIRST, 92-row fake-keyword table, disclaimer v3.1. (6) Factory apps are remembered per phone: once an app is proven to have come with the phone, it stays protected on that phone even if a later scan's signals miss it -- a factory app can never flip to removable by accident. (7) Every flagged app now shows WHY it is flagged right on its row -- no need to open it first. (8) The window now opens at HALF the screen, centered and clear of the dock, and remembers the size you leave it at. (9) The writing shows ONCE, on the row itself, and wraps inside the window at any size -- never cut off at the edge; and EVERY app shows its reading on its row without a click, clean apps included. (10) Stronger factory proof: an app whose program file sits in a factory part of the phone, or whose system flag is set, counts as factory and is remembered per phone the same way. (11) The hand pointer is gone -- the normal arrow everywhere. (12) The refresh button beside Source is bigger and easy to see. (13) The results rows are rebuilt as one column: the app name and its verdict sit on one line, and the writing sits directly underneath at the row's full width, re-wrapped at the window's real width every time the window changes size -- it can no longer be squeezed into a strip at the edge or run off the side at smaller windows. (14) Every scan now writes one extra log line per flagged app showing the raw factory evidence (where its program file lives, who installed it, its system flags), so a factory app that is not recognised can be diagnosed from the log alone. (15) At the small opening size the bottom totals bar and the summary line under the heading now stay whole: the totals rearrange into two rows so the Undo and Remove buttons are never cut off or pushed out of the window, and the summary line uses a shorter form of the same counts; at full size everything reads exactly as before. (16) Freeze-hardening revision: a watchdog guards the window while scans run and logs any stall. Twin of the Mac 11.12 build flipped the same day.
